rmi lam la rmi lam du shes dus rmi lam 'dzin pa med par mngon par dga' ba la sogs pa'i zhing khams bgrod par byed cing*/ de'i sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa'am rang nyid de'i ston par bsgyur te chos 'chad pa sogs so// rmi lam/ zhes pa mtha' ma spel sbyang*/ sprul bsgyur la bslab pa bstan te/ rmi lam du 'dzin pa ma dag pas rmi lam de nyid du ci shar ba la rmi lam yin pas gang dga' dgar bya btub snyam pas ya nga ba'i steng du thog brdzis/ bag tsha ba'i steng du lceb mchong brgyab/ ngan pa bzang por bsgyur ba la sogs pas rtsal sbyong ngo*// gsum pa ni/ gang zag mtha' ma des 'bring dang rab la rim pa bzhin bslab par bya'o// 'di yang rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge bdun gyi bdag nyid can// shing rtser kha dog dmar bsam nas// myur du lhung ba mi phyed par// sa rnams kyang ni gzhan du min// bdag gi lus la rnam bkod de// sa la ku sha'i stan la nyal// yi ge bdun gyi bdag nyid sngags// brgya rtsa brgyad ni nyid du bzlas// rmi lam du ni bya ba kun// yid la 'dod pa ston par 'gyur// zhes so// lnga pa mtshan 'dzin zung 'jug gi bcud du len pa bar do la/ rab chos skur grol tshul/ 'bring longs skur/ mtha' ma sprul skur grol tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ bar ma do la gshis kyis blta// zhes pas/ tshe 'dir 'od gsal sngon du byas/ mthar mi phyin pa de la bar ma do ni mchog gi bar do/ de yang 'chi kar chags sdang zhen pa'i 'khri ba kun bcad/ bla ma la 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol ba btab/ yan lag gi rlung sdud pas gzugs sogs yul snang nub/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung sa chu la thim/ lus kyi zungs shor/ chu me la thim pas skom zhing kha sna bskams/ me rlung la thim pas drod yal/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas phyi dbugs chad/ nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar der snang ba'i dus spyi mgrin gyi rtsa 'khor zhig nas dkar cha mar babs dus dkar lam/

mched pa'i dus/ de nas gsang gnas dang lte ba'i rtsa 'khor zhig pas dmar cha yar 'ongs dus dmar lam/ thob pa'i dus de gnyis snying gar 'dzom mun pa lta bu/ 'od gsal ma 'char dus ston ka'i gnam nyi ma'i 'od kyis khyab pa lta bur 'byung ngo*// de lam du byed pa ni thim rim gyi steng du sems glod pas snga ma rang ngo shes pas grol zhing*/ phyi ma rnams 'jug pa med pas phyi dbugs 'chad kar snang rgyu med de/ de ka la 'od gsal gyi mes thim rim sbyangs pa zer/ rgyu des 'chi dus der rang bzhin 'od gsal la sgrib mkhan bag chags ldang rgyu med pas ma bu 'phrod/ de las dag pa sgyu lus su ldang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ bar do'i rlung sems dhū tīr 'ching*// zhes pa 'di'i dhū tī ni phra ba'i dbu ma der 'ching ba ste 'di la rags pa'i rtsa med pas so// de yang tshe 'dir sgyu lus 'byongs pa zhig la snang ba rkyen gyi bar do 'char des phyed dang bzhi tshigs la bab pa na 'chi ba la 'chi bar shes/ de lam du byed pa ni/ da lta rdo rje rba rlabs ltem/ der sgra dang gzugs ci shar thams cad la 'di ni bar do yin/ chos nyid kyi rang sgra rang 'od kyi lha'o snyam pas lhar bsgom pa dang sems rang thog tu gzhag go /de 'byongs nas 'chi ka mar chags sdang zhen pa'i 'khri ba med par byas/ bla ma la bar do ngo sprod pa'i gsol ba gdab/ thim rim ngos gzung*/ 'chi ba'i skad cig las yid gzugs su langs/ 'chi ba bar do shes pa'i dus der bar do'i gdams ngag dran pa kho nas lam chod pas bar do blo chod/ gdams ngag kyang rang bde mchog yab yum/ sgra thams cad sngags/ sems 'od gsal stong nyid du dran pa'o// des dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i snang brnyan ji lta bar gyur nas bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams bgrod de rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la chos mnyan byang chub kyi spyod pa yongs su sbyong bas longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang rgya ba'i tha snyad byas so// gsum pa ni/

lam khyer gsum gyi gnad ldan pas// des ni bar do rang sangs rgya// zhes pas/ da lta dbang gsum pa la sogs pas chags sdang mig ser med/ spyi don sgyu ma 'byongs/ rmi lam zin/ spel tsam thub pa de la srid pa bar do 'char la/ phyed dang bzhi tshun brgyal/ de nas sad/ las snang gi bar do'i snang ba sna tshogs 'char de dag la bred nas skyabs 'tshol ba'am pha ma mthong nas chags sdang gi blo skyes na de nyid du mngal du chud par 'gyur la/ srid pa de yang gang du skye 'gyur gyi srid pa de'i sha tshugs zas dri za ba las kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ las mthun pa'i bar srid nang mthong res yod/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes thob pas mthong ba ni/ 'dod pa'i lha'i mig gis rang sa'i bar srid mthong ba lta bu gdams ngag ni/ 'chi kar bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ gang du skye 'dod pa'i smon lam dang 'pho bas mtshams sbyar/ 'chi dus su chags zhen spangs pa gtso bo yin/ de nas lam khyer bar do rang du ngo shes pas 'jigs skrag thams cad la sgyu ma lta bur rgyas btab pas mngal mi 'dod pa bgag shes pa/ gang 'dod kyi pha ma yi dam du bsgoms nas nang dbang len pa bsam pas pha'i spyi bo nas zhugs pa'am/ dag pa'i zhing du 'pho shes pa'i gnad gsum ldan pa'o// des bar do sprul pa'i skur 'gyur ro// rtsa rgyud las/ de nas 'di las yang dag 'thob// gsol bar gyur na gdon mi za// 'jigs pa'i dgra ni rnam mang po// mi bzad mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed pa// dpa' bo 'jigs par gyur na ni// skrag cing rnam par 'byer bar byed// gal te dpa' bo mi 'jigs na// lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas ni// rang gi gnas su khyer nas su// mkha' 'gro ma ni de dag dang*// rtag tu mngon par rtse bar byed// he ru ka dpal gus 'dod pas// mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su 'khyer// sgrub pa po ni sngags lus can// 'khor bar 'chi dang rga ba med// ces gsungs so// drug pa mtshan 'dzin ye shes kyi dbyings su btang ba 'pho ba la/

dmigs pa rten gyi gnad/ byed pa rlung gi gnad/ 'pho sa smon lam gyi gnad gsum las/ dang po ni/ gang las 'pho na/ rnam smin gzugs las/ zhes pa/ gang 'pho na/ rig pa 'pho/ zhes pa/ tshul ji ltar 'pho na/ rdo rje lus la sgra gcan gcig /ces pa lus rnal 'byor ma stong ra'i dbus su dbu ma steng rgya mthongs phye ba lta bu tshangs bug tshun sleb pa/ de'i nang du yi ge'i 'bru/ bsams la/ zhes pa/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du sems kyi ngo bo a dkar po// de'i 'og tu tshe'i ngo bo hi/ de'i 'og tu srog gi ngo bo phaṭ/ bde chen gnas dag tu/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma nyid// de yi thugs su yig 'bru ni// zhes pas/ spyi bor bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐/ yang na rnam shes rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ klu sogs kyis ni 'phang bar bya// zhes pa/ gang gi 'phen byed steng rlung brngubs/ 'og rlung 'then te kha sbyor bum pa can bkag pa'i mthar 'dren stangs sbyor ba drug tshang bas gyen du 'then pas/ a hi phaṭ kyis bskul te spyi bo nas brgyangs kyis bton yi dam gyi thugs kar 'phang*/ byang ba la zug pa dang spyi bo tsam nas slog 'then dus mgo mjug log par 'ongs nas sngar gyi sar ma log par 'dug pa'o// gsum pa ni/ mkha' la spyod cing*/ zhes pas/ mkha' spyod gsum gang du smon pa der 'gro'o// de yang rab 'bring mtha' ma'i gdul bya la bltos pa'o// sgra gcan nang*/ rlung sems tshud pas 'pho bar byed// ces pas/ tshangs bug rang nas gzugs med dang*// dbu ma sbyangs pa der zug pa nas 'phos na sku gsum gyi zhing gang 'dod pa der 'phen no// de'i rgyu mtshan/ dang po 'chi dus dkar dmar 'bab 'dzeg gyes pa'i dus su de yal zhing*/ dbu ma sbyangs pa la/ dkar dmar dang lhan cig de yar mas rim gyis yal bar bshad pas so// 'di yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/

rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe// khrag 'thung dpal sogs rnal 'byor ma// lag na me tog sna tshogs dang*// rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang*// rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs glu yis mchod pa yis// 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// ces pas bstan no// gsum pa zhu ba'i bde ba rnam bcas su bslangs nas chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag dbang gsum pa'i lam la/ yid thugs rdo rjer ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang dang*/ smin nas grol bar byed pa btsan thabs pho nya'i lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes rab dang*/ zhes pas bstan te/ gsang ba shes rab ma'i ye shes gtso bor bton pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ gnyis pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba rang lus bsgrub pa dang*/ dngos gzhi gzhan lus las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rab yid kyi rig ma la mnyam par sbyor ba dang*/ dman pa lag pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas sgrub pa/ rjes byang sems mi nyams par bya ba'i gnad bshad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ shes rab ye shes dag la ni// 'phel byed mdun du pad can bsam// rang lus/ zhes pas/ rang 'khor lo'i bdag por nges pa'i mdun du phyag rgya pad+ma can gyi bu mo yid du 'ong ba'i phul du phyin pa zhig bsam/ de dang gdong blta ba dang*/ rgod pa dang rtse ba dang reg pa dang 'khyud pa nyer gnas la blta ba sogs yid kyis ring du brtags la chags pa skye ba dang dngos 'dzin gyi mkhan po rtsad bcad pas de lam du gtong ba zhag 'ga'i bar du bya/ de nas de bcom ldan 'das mar bsgyur te sku gsung thugs go cha skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur/ rgyas btab/ gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ skye gnas a las pad+ma ze 'bru hrīḥmatshan pa phaṭ kyis bu ga bkag par bltas te 'og drag por 'then pa'i bum pa can du gzung*/

snyoms par zhugs pas khu ba 'dar ba dga' ba/ 'phar ba mchog dga'/ 'dzag pa khyad dga'/ ma 'phos pa'i gang bas lhan cig skyes dga'/ gnam la gdong gtad kyi/ zla ba mi 'chugs 'phel ba'i gnad// ces pa/ de'i tshe mig dang rlung sems steng gi nam mkhar bcings te gzhag pas bde ba ste rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid 'char/ des bde ba de la 'khyud pas khu ba mi 'dzag la/ rjes su dran pa zhes pa'i don yang de'o rtsa rgyud las/ yid ni nang du chud pa yis// 'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub par bya// zhes dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ bdag gi de nyid rdo rje 'dzin// bdag gi dbus su chud byas nas// 'khor lo can kun bsdu bar bya// thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du// byas nas de tshe rang bzhin sgom// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ de 'grub par dka' na/ g.yon gyi sbyor bas rtsa lam bkag /zhes pas/ cung zad gan rkyal/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis zla ba'i lam bkag pa/ g.yas kyi sbyor bas byang sems 'bebs// zhes pa/ g.yas bcom ldan 'das mar bsams te yab yum sngar bzhin snyoms 'jug byas par mos te dal bus rdo rje gsor ro// myong ba ngos zin pa ni sngar bzhin no/// /gsum pa ni/ nang dbye/ 'dzin/ 'byed/ 'dren/ 'grems/ 'bebs/ bde ba phyag rgya chen por skyel ba drug gi dang po/ bsdam glod/ ces pa ni dru bzhud lta bu'i rlung gnad de/ rlung rang 'gag gis pho ba brgyangs/ 'og sgo gnyis rang sar bzhag de ka'i steng nas rlung 'then/ rgyab glod/ mi thub na brngub chung byas/ yang de bzhin/ yang mi thub la khad na sngar bzhin bya ba 'dzin stangs gcig la'o// de rjes phyir 'bud drag po gsum la 'dren stangs bya'o// mtshams su thig le bzung*/ zhes pa/ bde ba rdzogs mtshams su/ gnyis pa/ dwangs snyigs 'byed/ ces pa rgya mtsho g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du lan gsum gsum du bskor zhing rdeb pa gsum byas/

rdo rje bsdams pa las/ rdo rje rtse gcig gis rgyu zhabs su bsnun pas dwangs snyigs phye'o// gsum pa/ lha rnams sprug cing gza' rnams bzlog /ces pa la gnyis kyi/ ma bzung rlung gi zhes pa dang 'dren ni/ rlung rang 'gag lus g.yas 'then/ g.yon/ cha mnyam/ mgo bo g.yas g.yon dbus/ g.yon skor gsum/ mi thub la khad na mthar lus sprug dbang po rnams gyen la bzlog pas 'dar chung si li li byed pa'o// snyigs 'dren dwangs snyigs 'byed/ rlung phyir 'bud nang du mi 'dzin/ sems skyil pus bkab rlung phyir 'bud drag pos g.yas 'then g.yon nas lus sprug pa lan snga ma bzhin no// de nas spros pa che na 'dren bcu gcig bya ste/ gnas su ma 'khyol na chu dang bsdongs te 'dzag pa'o// bzhi pa 'grems la/ ri rab stod smad bar gsum rdeb// ri rab sprug cing gling bzhi brkyang*// gnam la 'phang zhing*/ zhes pa/ rlung bum pa can gzung gan rkyal gyi mgo sprug cing rdeb/ de las skyed pa dang phongs/ de nas yan lag phyogs bzhir brkyang sprug kha sbub tu yang bya/ mthar bag bzhi 'khrab/ rgyas par stod smad bar gsum gyi rnal rol sogs kyang bya ste/ lus la ma khrems na bzlog kyang nang kyi rgyur 'gro'o// lnga pa snyigs ma 'bor/ ces pa/ de'i mthar 'bebs byas nas gsang rtsa bzhos/ snyigs ma 'bor/ ma pho na lus la sha lhad 'byung ngo*// drug pa/ bcos min shes pa gtan la 'bebs// zhes pa de'i mthar/ bum pa can 'ga' yar bsgom/ sems ma bcos pa la mnyam par gzhag pas sbyor skor de lam du 'gro'o// rlung dang ma 'dres na sa dbang du shor nas/ mthar gnyid chog pa sogs 'byung*/ phyag chen du skyel ma shes na zab kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi gzhan lus las la sbyar ba la/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rten btsal/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa bstan/ gnas skabs gnyis kyi 'bras bu bzhag pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/

rig ma dag dang*/ zhes pa/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams las/ rnal 'byor ma so drug gi dbye bas phyag rgya dpag med cig bshad kyang*/ rtsa rigs kyis bzhag pa 'di dag mkho ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las rtsub ces bya ba ni ba lang gi lce ltar rtsub pa'o// 'jam pa ni pad+ma can zhes bya'o// mkhrang ba ni khu ba sra ba ste/ gang gi khu ba 'thas par 'gyur ba'o// 'dzer pa can ni dung can ma ste pad+ma la sha 'dzer yod pa'o// bud med 'di dag gi bcud 'ching ba la dbang du gyur ba yin no// zhes dang po glang sna can/ gsum pa ri mo can/ na tshod kyang rgyud der/ chung ngu ni dang po bcu gcig ma'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang rol bas bcud kyis len bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa lo bcu gnyis ma dang rol bas dam tshig gi don du rol bar bya'o// gsum pa bcu drug ma dang lhan cig tu dga' bas ni sngags rnams goms par bya ba'o// bzhi par lo nyi shu ma dang nam mkhar 'phur ba bsgrub par bya'o// lnga par lo nyi shu rtsa lnga ma dang bskur ba'o// zhes pas dmar cha 'dren pa mtshan nyid rtsa rigs gong dang ldan pa/ na tshod 'di dag gi dbang du byas pa dgug pa dang mi snang ba sogs rgyas pa las so// de ltar rnyed pa so so thar pa dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rgyud legs par sbyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la/ rtsa ba snyoms 'jug gi gnad/ sangs rgya ba btsan thabs kyi gnad/ rjes shes sbyang ba lam khyer gyi gnad gsum/ dang po ni/ mnyam sbyor/ zhes pas rgyud sbyangs pa de dang rtsed 'jo sna tshogs pas bde ba bskul te/ skyes pa dang ngos 'dzin gyis lam du btang*/ goms nas rtsed 'jo'i mthar phan tshun lha bskyed pa nas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas te snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chil skyes pa so so rang rig gi steng du blta'o// de nas snga ma las drag par bskyod de bde ba sngar las che ba dang*/

ches che ba dang lhan cig skyes dgar 'jog pa'i bar thams cad rigs 'dra de yang yul gyi ngos nas stong bzhi/ dus kyi ngos nas skad cig ma bzhi/ yul can rang ngos nas dga' ba bzhi yin no// 'dir yang rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ mtha' ma'i chags chen rim pa yis// 'khor lo can kun bsdus nas ni// btsun mo'i bha gar bde chen spro// der ni dkyil 'khor kun tu bri// gzhan gyis de nyid ji bzhin gsungs// zhes bshad la/ 'dir bha gar spro ba'i tshul ni thig le 'byin pa ma yin la/ btsun mo'i bha gar yas brtan gyi dga' ba mthar thug pa byas pas de rang lus su bshad pa bzhin gyis rnam kun mchog ldan du bslang ba la byed dgos/ gzhan dri med 'od las/ lan cig rtag tu khu ba ltung ba'i phyir// gnyis ka la yang mchog gi bde ba med// ces gsungs la bdud rtsi ril bu'i don/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ gegs sel ba'i dus su ni dgos pa khyad par can yin pa'i phyir 'bor la/ nus ldan gyi rtsal sbyong gi dus bha gar spros/ slar yang sdud pa'i phyir nyes par mi 'gyur ro// yan lag tshang ba'i khu ba nyams pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba lnga par bzhag pas bsgrim par bya'o// de bas byang sems gsang ba'i snar 'ching ba'i gnad kyi gtso bo ni so so rang rig pa'i ye shes/ de lta bu yang dang yang du nyams su bstar bas ci zhig na mas brtan gyi dga' ba rnyed de/ sa ra has za zhing 'thung la gnyis sprod kyis dga' zhing*/ rtag tu yang dang yang du 'khor lo 'gengs// chos 'di lta bus 'jig rten pha rol 'grub 'gyur te// rmongs pa'i 'jig rten mgo bo rdog pas mnan nas song*// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ rten gyi stobs/ sbyor ba'i stobs gnyis so// dang po ni/ dbang po rnams la bde ba'i nyams// zhes pas/ phyag rgya rab chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa sna phyir so gsum mam gnyis sam gcig don 'ong*/ dman kyang bskyod dus bu gar gra ma zug pa lta bu 'byung bas/

de rdo rje'i bu gar bcug pas rang gi dbu ma skom pa chu snyeg pa ltar 'ongs de gnyis po kha sbyar du grub/ de'i dbang gis snyoms 'jug gi rlung gnyis kha sbyar/ de nas dang por skyes pa'i zhu ba'i thig le de'i ze bar lhung*/ de'i rkyen gyis khams dmar po zhu yang der sleb pas thig le kha sbyar/ sngar gyi dbang po gnyis dang bcas pas kha sbyar bzhi/ rang gi dbu ma'i sna rtser lhung ba de yan dga' ba/ shes rab kyi dwangs ma dang phrad pas mchog dga'/ de yan chags pa'i phyogs/ de stong nyid du langs pas gnyis ka ro mnyam pa dang chags pa dang chags bral 'dres pa de'i dus su sngar goms par byas pa la lhan skyes kyi ye shes mtshan nyid pa 'char te/ de yang dri med 'od las/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ rnam pa thams cad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa zhes mtshan nyid gsum ldan du gsungs pa bzhin de'i mthus khams de gyen du log phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad dwangs mar 'gyur ba de ma rig pa'i 'gyur ba zad pas so// de yang dbang po rab de nyid du 'tshang rgya ba ni/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dum bu gcig gis reg pa'i mod la lcags bsregs pa khal stong gser du 'gyur ba lta bu'o// gzhan de dus nas rlung dbu mar thim pa'i 'go tshugs stong brgyad brgya thim tshar nas sa dang po'i ye shes rdzogs la lhag ma rnams kyang shes par bya'o// mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgya// zhes dang*/ rje mar pas/ bsgoms na 'tshang rgya kun kyang rgya// ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la/ rdo rje nyi ma dbang sdud dang*// sba ba sbubs 'then gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dug stangs dang*/ thur ma la brten pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnad rnams kyis ni/ zhes pa'i rnams sgras/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ gang zhig chags pa sra ba rnams la ni sor mo ring po gsum sbrul gyi mgo ltar byas la mo mtshan gyi bu gar bcug nas sa ti ces pa'i sgra byung ba'i bar du drud pas rgan mo la sogs pa yang ni rdo rje gsor zhes bya'o// gang zhig gzhon zhing mnyen pa rnams la ni/

rang gi mtshan ma 'od dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems 'bab pa'i rtsar btsug ste gsil ba tsam gyis dga' bar byas te/ rdo rje lce'i thur ma zhes bya'o// zhes dang*/ ji snyed bstan chos thams cad las byung ba'i ka ra ṇa bsnyen par byas te de thams cad kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgyar brjod do// zhes pas/ phyag rgya gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i tshangs rar stegs bcug rkang pa bskum pa'i pus mo phan tshun du mnan/ mchan khung gnyis su 'bol rdo khu tshur/ nyis sbyar tsam re bcug de gong nem tsam gyis bsdams pa'i mdud pa mdun du byed/ lce cung zad brkyang du bcug 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes/ tshul de lta bu la bsnun pas rtsa la thug de bu gar 'jug thub ma byung na/ phyag rgya'i rkang pa gnyis rang gi gdong phyogs su drag tu 'then du bcug nas dal bus btsal bas 'grub/ rgyas par spro na/ g.yas brkyang yum 'og tu bzhag pa'i brla bar du g.yon pus mo btsugs rting pa g.yon pas gsang rtsa mnan pas bskyod/ g.yon brkyang de bzlog pa/ mnyam pa phyag rgya dang gnyis ka'i pus mo phyir dgyed pa/ lag par dpyi nas btang*/ mi mnyam pa de'i g.yas bskum/ yang g.yon bskum/ gnyis car shad brkyang bas dbus su bskyod pas so// rdo rje goms pa la gnyis/ rang skyil krung lhod de ba byas pa'i pang du blangs nas rang rkang pa 'khril nas langs pa/ yum yang langs pas/ sa ga rang gan rgyal ba'i steng du yum bzhag pa/ zlum po rang sked pa bsrangs la mdun du brkyang*/ yum yang de bzhin/ ru sbal ni yum gyi steng du yab rkang pa bskum pa'i nur 'gros/ bung ba yab steng nas rkang pa drag tu bkug pa/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ yab gan rkyal gyi lag pas brla bzung ba'i steng du yum bzhag pas/ ri bo 'degs/ rang gan rkyal rkang brkyang gi khar phyag rgya bzhag ste snyoms 'jug gong 'og gnyis ka'i mthar 'dzin sogs rang lus bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ sbyang sad/

las sbyar las/ dang po ni/ 'di yang*/ gnad rnams kyis ni/ zhes pa'i rnams sgras bstan te/ lus pus btsugs bar la mtho gsum tsam yong ba lus steng du lag pa rdo rje khu tshur bzhag nas rlung bzung*/ pho skor g.yas g.yon gnyis kar gsum gsum/ rlung de stod la shed bskyed la 'then/ lag pa g.yon ma gug par brla sha g.yon gyi kha nas yar nud tsam spo rung 'ong*/ brla khugs su sleb pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs kyi stod shed bskyed la 'then/ yang rlung de phyir shed bskyed nas 'bud pa dang lag mgo pus mgor skyel ba sgrag yang g.yon phyogs kyi stod 'then/ de bzhin g.yas la'ang bya'o// dbus nas mdun rgyab kyi rlung 'then/ mdun rlung pho ba bkang gsang gnas su rdeb pa lan gsum/ de nas bskor ba stod 'then phyir 'bud rnams snga ma bzhin no// 'di thun drug tu nyams su len cing zhag bcu'i bar du sbyangs/ rdo rje la mar byugs nas zhag gsum gyi gong nas yang yang mnye/ de nas lcags zangs sam smyug ma'i thur ma sbubs yangs po yod pa mtho gang sor bzhi yod pa shin tu 'jam pa bu ga nas 'og tu zhar gyis thal te btang*/ rlung gyen 'dren gyis steng du 'don pa ni/ rang 'gag gi rlung pho gar shed bskyed la brgyangs/ mi thub pa na de nas shed bskyed la 'bud/ ha zhes stod du drag por 'then/ 'dren bzhi la rtags 'don bya/ rlung thur bsdigs kyis 'og tu 'don pa ni/ lag sor bcu drug mdor btsugs/ stod cung zad dgye byas/ mdun rlung thur du drag tu 'phul ba dang 'pho ba nas 'og tu rdeb pa thur/ brgyangs kyis 'thon/ sad pa ni thur ma btsugs nas gyen 'dren gyis rang drod tsam gyi chu drangs/ kha snar mthon ring sbyangs/ thur bsdigs kyis lus la mi bzhag par phyir 'bod do// des 'o ma dang khrag 'dren nus pa red nas thur ma med pa la bslab/ las sbyor ni 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes pa/ thur ma med pa la goms nas sngar bzhin gyis sam/

thur ma dgos na bud med kyi dwangs ma 'bab chen 'bab chung gi dus sam mnyam par phyag rgya su bha ga dang mnyam par sbyar te thig le dum bu gcig btang bas de'i dwangs ma 'bab/ de dus thur ma btsugs te drang ngo*// 'di drangs nas dkar cha las sum 'gyur gyi 'dren sogs gnad du bsnun dgos so// de yang rang gi dkar dmar dang 'dres te/ stobs rgyas/ mdangs legs/ bkrag mtshar/ skye dgu'i yi gar yong*/ rgas pa'i 'jigs pa med/ drod lhag par 'phel bas nad med/ 'ja' lus su dwangs/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gyur ro// rdo rje khong rgyongs dang*/ sro ma gyen bsgreng dang*/ bha ga chu sbed la sogs pa'i rdzas kyang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ ling gas bud med bsgrub bya zhing*// bha gas skyes pa bsgrub par bya// zhes sman la sogs pas rgyas par bshad do// 'di rtsa rgyud las/ dbug la 'das ni sbyar byas te// dus min 'chi ba blu ba la// yan lag kha ṭ+wāṃ dag dang sbyar// zhes pas so// gnyis pa la/ 'og tu rdo rje sbubs 'then gyis stod du gtsug tor bsgrub pa dang*/ dri chen sogs kyis dwangs ma sbyangs nas 'ja' lus su byed pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis drang ba/ bsnyen sgrub lha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ mkha' 'gro las kyi 'gugs byed kyis/ mthar thug ye rlung mnyam gnas kyis drang ba bzhi/ dang po la/ lus rlung dmigs pa'i gnad gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'di ril po yang*/ gnad rnams kyis ni/ zhes pa'i rnams sgras bstan la/ g.yon pa'i rting pas gsang rtsa mnan/ rdo rje 'bras bu dang bcas pa steng du 'thon pa byas/ g.yas pa de'i thad kyi rgyab tu bsten pa'i tshul du btsugs/ gnyis pa/ 'og sgo gnyis drag tu 'then te phyir shi shi gal gal 'bud/ mthar bum can/ gsum pa/ rang bde mchog yab yum du bsgoms pa'i rdo rje'i nor bu nas mgo bo'i tshangs bug gi bar du dbu ma sba lcag tsam thal le zug pa'i yas snar bla ma he ru ka'i chas can dug sbrul gyis thod bcings pa/

rgyal po rol pas bzhugs pa'i g.yas gser gyi nyag thag gi rtsa ba de'i mgo g.yon dngul gyi lcags kyu 'khyud gang tsam yod pa bsnams pa/ rang gi mas snar btang bas rdo rje phyir rgyangs 'thon/ lcags kyus rdo rje'i mgo nas rgyab lu gu rgyud phyag gnyis kyis shugs bskyed de 'then pas/ bum ca re la lte ba sogs gnas lngar sleb/ bla ma'i thugs kar rgyangs byung*/ rgyu ma phyir 'og byas pa lta bu dgye re yod par bsam/ rlung dbyung dus lu gu rgyud lhod btang bas sngar mal du gnas par bsam mo// 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes pas lus gnad bcas rlung mnan pa tsam gyis sbubs su nub par 'gyur/ gal te des ma thub na/ gnyis pa la/ thur sel gyen rgyu dang bsre ba/ gyen rgyu thur sel dang bsre ba/ dru ba zhud kyis 'dren pa gsum gyi dang po/ lus skyil krung lag bsnol pus bkab/ sgo gnyis drag por 'then/ rlung stod du shi shi gal gal sbyor ba drug ldan gyis 'bud pa'i mthar phyir 'dzin/ de 'dra gsum gnyis pa rlung brngubs te drag por 'og tu 'phul/ rlung tsam thub 'dzin/ mi thub pa dang dal bur btang 'phral la brngubs te mnan/ yang de bzhin bya ba gsum spel gyin 'khor mar sbyang*/ dmigs pa snga ma la snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i bu ga nas yar 'gro bas spyi bor 'thon pa dang*/ phyi ma la de go bzlog tu bya'o// gsum pa la/ gzhan 'dra/ dbu ma'i mar snar rdo rje lpags pa dang dbyer med du bsam/ sbrul sbubs su nub pa lta bu dbu ma'i nang du hril li li byung nas spyi bor 'bur byung bar bsam/ rgyab glod gsang rlung spyi bo'i bar du 'dren/ de bzhin mdun glod rgyab rlung de'i bar du 'then no// 'dis sba ba sbubs su nub cing steng du gtsug tor 'grub/ 'on kyang rdo rje de nyid gtsug tor du 'gyur ba ni ma yin te nus pa dus mnyam pa la dgongs so// gzhan sprul pa'i sku la btsun mo'i 'khor don med par 'gyur bas so// gsum pa ni/

rdo rje la lcags phye/ spyi bor khab len byug gzhan 'dra/ bzhi pa ni/ rtsa'i dwangs ma dbu ma 'ja' tshon lta bu 'og nas spyi bor zug rlung gi dwangs ma de dang mi phyed pa/ thig le'i dwangs ma rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis spyi bor bstim mo// 'di rtsa rgyud sngar gyi 'phror/ thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni// zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar// zhes pas so// gnyis pa dri chen sogs kyis dwangs ma sbyangs nas 'ja' lus su byed pa'i tshul ni/ gnad rnams kyis ni/ zhes pa'i rnams sgras bstan no// lus gnad gong ma bzhin/ dmigs pa rang lha yab rkyang gi spyi gtsug nas bshang lam rdo rje gnyis kyi bar la zug pa/ rtsa zangs kyi gzer bu btab pa lta bu'i sgo lus kyi gnas lnga'i thad na 'phred la zug pa lus kyi phyi dra mig lta bu/ rtsa snod re rer thig le dkar dmar 'thigs la khad pa re re/ lte 'og tu a shad/ sgo gnyis kyi thig le cher dwangs pa dkar por yod pa/ rlung steng nas bsdigs bskyur du brdzangs pas a shad las me bshang lam dang rdo rje gnyis su byung*/ thig le gnyis po 'od du zhu/ 'og rlung 'then bdas bdas pas a shad kyi sar bros/ rtsa'i gzer bu tsho nas yar 'ongs thig le rnams bzhu/ rtsa thams cad mer gang bar bsgoms te 'khrul 'khor la 'bad/ 'ju byed kyi sman bsten pas/ 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes/ snyigs ma med par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes shes sbyang ba lam khyer gyi gnad ni/ rjes kyi shes pa btson du zung*// zhes pas/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'dzag med du 'ching ba'i stobs med pas tha mal pa de la rjes kyi shes par brjod nas/ gang zag des dbab pa yang drag por mi rung ste/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ ma zin dbab drags mda' 'phangs 'dra// zhes gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar zhe na/ rje nā ro pa yab sras kyis/ 'bebs pa la mkhas pa ru sbal gyi 'gros// zhes pa lta bu/ bde ba 'go skye ba tsam la 'dzin/

de nas bzlog pa sogs bya/ yang bskyod pa'o// de bas 'dzin pa la/ rlung gi thems bu/ 'khrul 'khor gyi thems bu/ rdzas kyi thems bu gsum las/ dang po la/ rang sar 'dzin/ nang 'dzin/ phyi 'dzin/ ma ning gi thems bu bzhi/ dang po lus gang gis sbyor ba'i 'dug stangs/ rlung 'og glod rang 'gag gis spyi bo sogs gnas lnga gar phab pa de khar 'chun 'don pas 'khor lo lnga'i dbye bas lnga/ dang po yas rim/ goms nas mas rim gyis bsdoms pas bcu'o// nang 'dzin la yang lus 'dra la/ steng brngubs/ 'og glod nas gnas lnga so sor 'chun 'don pa'o// phyir 'dzin rlung phyir 'bud dang dus mnyam du gnas so sor 'chun 'don/ 'bud rgyu rdugs pa dang 'og glod de phyir 'dzin ma ning ni/ rlung phyir na ra ra rang shugs su 'gro ba'i mjug pad bcad nas rgyab 'then rgyu zhabs brgyangs/ de bzhin lte ba sogs su dang*/ yang nang du na ra ra 'ongs pa'i gzhug bcad*/ bar rlung mgo bor 'then 'chun 'don/ de bzhin mgrin pa sogs la yang ngo*// de nas dbye ba lnga cu de dag la byang nas rlung gcig la rdzogs par byed rdzas ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ bsrung ba'i dus su blo ldan gyis// rang gi lag pas rdo rje bzung*// zhes pa/ thig le rgyu ba'i lam rting pas gnon pa'am/ rang ngam shes rab kyi lag mtheb kyis gsang rtsa mnan pa/ de nas rdo rje'i bum pa/ mgo mnan pas so// de ltar bzung nas zin ma thag 'og sgo gnyis la 'gul skyod med par bar rlung drag por 'then/ phyir 'bud lan bcu gnyis bya/ ha zhes drag tu 'then cing phyir 'dzin/ de nas nang du brngubs/ bar rlung thur du 'phul/ 'og sgo gnyis kyang phyir drag tu 'phul/ tsam thub bgag mi thub na lte ba na bar rlung rdeb bskyur mang du bya'o// de lta bu ha dang ho dang ha hag ces pa la bdun bdun no// des ma 'drongs na/ phyag rgya dang bral bas rang lus kyi 'dren kyang bya'o// de ltar bzlog thub na rdo rje rang zhi ba dang smad yang gi 'gro/

'chun gar bton sar bde chas bskyed/ de nas sngar bzhin dwangs snyigs phye nas de nas 'grems te/ dwangs 'grems g.yas sa la phab/ de'i 'phar rtsa bsdams/ rlung rang 'gros kyi gzhug pad bcad de 'dar phrig pa bde zug dang bcas pa/ de dus rlung dgang ste bum pa can 'dzin/ g.yon la'ang de bzhin/ skyil krung gis bkag ste pho bar mnan/ dbugs ma bde ba shugs ring na re ba 'ong*/ de dus rlung gzhug nang dang phyir bzung bas bde ba skye/ g.yas su'ang de bzhin/ snyigs 'grems rang lus bzhin no// mthar 'bebs dang rang lus bzhin gyi snyigs ma 'bod/ de nas bum pa can mang du 'dzin/ bde ba gang skyes de dang phyi'i snang ba bsres pas thams cad bde chen du 'char bar 'gyur ro// de lta bus phyag rgya ma bsten pa'i skyon/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ skye bo thabs dang bral ba na// tshul ngan dman pa dka' bas sgrub// bdag nyid sgrub pa dang bral bas// skal med ngal ba don med cing*// de la dngos grub zhes mi brjod// ces dang*/ bsten dus de nyid du/ nyi ma re re zhing ngo*// yang na zla bas so// yang lo re bzhin te/ zhes 'byung*/ gang zag khyad par 'phags par yang*// bstan pa smod pas 'jigs pa na// rang sems tsam la mos pa bya// zhes sam bu ṭar gsungs pa bzhin bya'o// gnad mi shes par bsten na/ he ru ka sngon 'byung las/ rnal 'byor med par rnal 'byor chos// phyag rgya la ni bgrod gyur dang*// ye shes med par ye shes tshul// dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med// zhes so// bsten pa'i phan yon/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ gang gi blun po 'ching gyur ba// 'dir des mkhas rnams rnam grol zhes// phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni// sa gsum ma lus bza' bar bya// gzhan du gal te sbyor ba ni// ma tshang mar me lta bu 'da'// zhes pa ste/ de phyir rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya ral gri'i so dang 'dra// zhes gsungs/ lam 'di yang rtsa rgyud las/

kha dog pho nya sogs sngags gang*// mda' yi shugs kyis yongs su bskor// phan tshun 'dud rgyud dpa' bo ni// yul nyid kyis ni phye ba'o// sa bon 'phreng ba de nas bzung*// hūm̐ gi mtha' ru gnas pa yin// bsgrub bya 'gog par gyur pa ni// goms pa gcig kyang mi 'gro'o// kha sbyar sbyar bar gyur pa dang*// rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings pas// rdo rje dbye ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin bung ba ltar 'khor bya// lcags kyu nyid kyis dgug pa dang*// gtun shing gis bskyod de bzhin te// rdo rje nyid kyis 'debs par bshad// ces pas so// bzhi pa gnas skabs gnyis kyi 'bras bu bzhag pa ni/ 'phral ni/ mtha' ma 'du ba rnam gsum 'gyur// zhes pa/ 'du ba rnam gsum yang gsang bar rtsa gnas su srog dang thig le 'du/ nang du dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro 'du/ phyir skye bo pho mo dang zas nor longs spyod 'du'o// 'bring ni dwangs ma'i lus su 'gyur/ de phyir las rgya'i 'bras bu 'dod pa'i rig 'dzin du dus 'khor las bshad pa rkyang pa'i dbang du mdzad la/ 'dir phyag rgya gnyis gzhi gcig la 'du bas 'og min pa'i bar sgrub pa yin no// mthar thug ni/ rab kyi tshe 'dir 'ja' lus 'thob/ 'dir 'ja' lus ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te spyod rgyud du/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus dag ni// de nyid bsgoms pas thob par 'gyur// zhes bshad do// bzhi pa dmigs bcas thams cad dmigs med du ro mnyam ste lhan cig skyes pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag dbang bzhi pa'i lam la/ rnam shes ye shes su ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang*/ smin zin grol bar byed pa phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bzhi pa'i rim pas smin par byed// ces pas tshig dbang dang*/ gnyis pa la/ ngo sprod lta ba'i skor/ mnyam gzhag sgom pa'i skor/ lam khyer spyod pa'i skor/

mthar phyin 'bras bu'i skor dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ brjod du med cing*/ zhes pas/ lus sems rnal du phab nas rtog pa'i rgyun sbad de bcad pa'i dus der bsam du med pa brjod pas gtan la mi phebs pa'i rang lugs cig 'dug pa de ka ma skyes pa gzhi'i gnas lugs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang tha mi dad pa'o// yul las 'das/ zhes pa/ yul las 'das nas gzhan du 'gro ba ste/ de rkyen bum pa lta bu dang phrad na/ bum 'dzin rtog par 'char/ de sngar med pa la gsar du byung bas ci skyes thams cad rtog pa/ rkyen gnyis pa ka ba lta bu zhig dang phrad na snga ma'i bum 'dzin nub nas phyi ma'i ka 'dzin langs pas rtog pa de tshugs mi thub pas glo bur ba/ spros bral zhes pa/ rtog pa de ka snang dus su yang de nyid du ma grub pas skyes pa dang ma skyes pa de gnyis gnyis su med pas spros bral te/ don bu ram la gzugs du ma byas pas/ snang bya'i ngos nas du ma/ ro'i ngos nas mngar mor gcig pa bzhin du/ gdangs kyi ngos nas du ma/ gshis kyi ngos nas gcig pas 'khor 'das dbyer med du bshad do// sa ra has/ ma skyes pa las rtog pa glo bur ba// rtog pa de nyid dbyings kyi ngo bo yin// zhes pas so// nam mkha'i/ zhes pa de yang*/ mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing dbus mi dmigs pas nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu'o zhes rtag chad las 'das par bstan/ ngo bo nyid/ ces pa/ gzhi de rtogs pa na sdug bsngal thams cad zad pas de nyid la gnas lugs bde ba chen po zhes btags so// gnyis pa ni/ shes rab ye shes chen po ni/ zhes pa/ rab bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis lta sgom spyod pa ro mnyam du rtogs te bsgom bya sgom byed med pas 'bad med du grol bas shes rab chen po dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes so// 'bring*/ blta na rang gi sems la ltos// zhes pa/ lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba zhes bya ste/ lta bas gtan la phab pa de ka la yid la mi byed pas mnyam par gzhag go

/yid la mi byed pa yang sems ji bzhin du gzhag pa las gzhan gnyen pos bcos mi gdab pa'o// de yang*/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// de ring mgon po nga ltar 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la'ang 'dri bar mi bya'o// zhes pas so// mtha' ma la/ sems kyi rang lugs dang mthun par sgom te/ lus rang babs su gzhag dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad/ bram ze skud pa 'khal ba bzhin du grims lhod snyoms par bya'o// de yang*/ bsam dang bsam bya thams cad yongs su dor nas su// ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin// bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na// lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med// ces so// gsum pa ni/ bzhi pa bskur ba'i rnal 'byor pas// zhes pa/ dbang bzhi pa thob nas chos can thams cad chos nyid rnal ma la 'byor bas te/ mnyam nyid khong du chud pas so// bzhi pa ni/ de ltar rtogs na 'bras bu 'thob// ces pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs mthong bas sa lam ma lus pa rtogs pa gcig gis bgrod pa'o// de yang*/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes pas so// 'di rtsa rgyud las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur tam// ma byung na yang rnam kun tu// bsam mi khyab pa'i chos nyid ni// 'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin// de ltar rnam par gzhag nas kyang*// 'jig rten pa kun yongs mi smad// de yi bgrod pa bsam yas shing*// sangs rgyas rol pa bsam mi khyab// ces pas bstan no// lnga pa bya spyod thams cad he ru ka'i rol mor btang nas btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag spyod pa 'jigs bral rdo rje'i mtshon cha la/ 'byor pa can gtsang sbra rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas kun bzang gi spyod pa mthar phyung ba/ ku sa li spyod yul bzhi'i sgo nas gsang spyod lam du slong ba/

nus ldan gyi gang zag rig pa'i brtul zhugs la brten nas he ru ka'i rol pas 'da' ba/ 'tshang rgya kha ma dngos grub kyi nye rgyur phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa brtsam pa bzhi las/ dang po la/ pho nya'i gtsang sbra/ zhi ba'i gtsang sbra/ snod gcig tu za ba'i gtsang sbra ste gsum/ dang po ni/ mdor bstan du/ rdo rje lam mchog ces pas/ spros bcas la rang rang phyag rgya bcu gsum dang bcas te brda dang brda'i lan gyi 'dus te/ tha mal pa'i 'jug pa bgags pas phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga ji lta bas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ste/ 'di yang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid// lus la thams cad byas nas ni// yan lag las 'das mtshon cha rnams// lus la gnas pas kun tu spyad// lus ni dag byed byas nas su// rtag tu sngags ni brjod nas ni// rnal 'byor gnas rnams nges bstan cing*// mtshon cha rnams ni bsgom mi bya// dam tshig can la khro mi bya// mngon par brtson las 'da' mi bya// de dang lhan cig bde bar bya// grol ba'i don dang bde don du// dam tshig spyod pa nyid du bya// zhes sogs pas so// spros med ni phyag rgya drug dang*// lo la re'am dgun zla 'bring po ril po la'o// shin tu spros med ni/ rang gi khyim du phyag rgya gcig dang lhan cig las te/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar mar gyi tshes bcu la brtsam mo// des sems zhi gnas stong par dben par 'gyur te/ lha sngags phyag rgya'i rol mor gyur pas so// gnyis pa ni/ de nyid pa ni de nyid kyis// zhes pa/ rtsa rgyud las/ rnam 'phrul sems pa las grol zhing*// zhes/ de la goms par byas na zhi ba'i gtsang sbrar 'gyur te/ de yang dngos por 'dzin pas dben pas na lha sngags phyag rgya de dag sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rdo rje'i lus/ zhes pa/ snang grags thams cad sbyangs shing lus dwangs ma 'ja' lus su bsgyur nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams myul ba rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti lta bu ste/

de'i tshe snod gcig tu za ba'i gtsang sbra ste/ stong pa'i ye shes snang bas dben pas so// rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya gtsang sbra dang po yin// gnyis pa zhi ba yin par 'dod// snod gcig tu ni za ba dag /gtsang sbra gsum pa yin par bshad// ces so// de bas na/ dang po bum dbang*/ gnyis pa gsang dbang*/ gsum pa dbang gong ma gnyis dang 'brel ba'i spyod par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la/ phyi gcod gzung ba'i yul la bya ba/ nang gcod 'dzin pa sems la bya ba/ bar gcod sgyu ma'i gzugs la bya ba/ gsang gcod lha 'dre stong pa'i gzugs brnyan la bya ba bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gnad ces pa gcod yul gyi gnad do// 'di zhes pa snang zhing grags pa thams cad la'o// de yang*/ phyi snang ba 'di thams cad ji ltar snang*/ ji ltar grags kyang*/ ma rtogs pa'i dus na de dang de dag tu gzung bas phyi yul gyi snang ba de nas bden bden mor song ste/ des lus can thams cad 'ching bar byas pa/ dper bgyis na rdzun smra mkhas pa'i rdzun tshig bzhin// de phyir 'di dag snang na 'khrul snang ngo*// de rtogs pa rnams la mi 'ching ba'i khar grol ba'i rkyen nam grogs su 'gro ste/ dngos por ma grub pas sgyu ma lta bur snang la/ sgyu ma lta bu la sgyu ma lta bus rtsal sbyangs pas/ mthar thug pa na snang ma myong ba rtogs te rdzun gyi phugs rdib pa lta bu'o// de ltar shes pas 'jig rten chos brgyad la sgyu ma lta bur blta zhing thog brdzis su byas pas der 'dzin gyi mkhan po zad nas snang ba skye med du 'dag go /mai tri pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa rje btsun gyis/ skyes mchog mar par 'di skad gsung*/ phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul pa ste// phyi yul gyi snang bas 'ching bar byed// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang sems kyi grogs su 'char// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos skur dag go gsung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/

gnad/ nyid/ ces pa/ snang ba phyir 'phul mkhan gzhan na med/ nang 'gyu ba yid kyi rnam par shes pa'am 'dzin pa 'di nyid yin no// de yang*/ ma rtogs pas ma rig pa zhes bzhag ste lus thams cad nyon mongs par byed pa'i gzhi'am rtsa bar 'gyur ro// ma rig pa snang dus de khar ma grub par rtogs pa la rang rig pa'i ye shes zer/ gzhan gyi rkyen 'jug pa med pas so// de tsa na thar pa dang goms pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rdzogs par 'gyur te/ ma rig pa'i 'gyur ba zad pa nyid bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin la/ thar pa'i gnas skabs thams cad ni de ngo ma 'gyur ba'i ldog pas dbye ba tsam du zad la/ mthar thug pa na rang gi rig rgyu de kho na nyid med pas ye shes kyang med pas na chos thams cad zad sar sus 'khyol ba de la sangs rgyas su btags par 'dug go snyam nges pas/ 'gyu ba skad cig gnyis su yan mi 'jug par rang ngo rang shes kyis thog brdzis su bya'o// de yang rdze btsun gyis/ nang 'gyu ba yid kyi rnam shes 'di// ma rtogs dus na ma rig pa// las nyon mongs kun gyi gzhi rtsa byed// rtogs na rang gi ye shes de// dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs par 'byung*// mthar thug don la ye shes med// chos rnams zad sar skyol lo gsungs// gsum pa ni/ gnad/ las/ zhes pa/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su sbyor mkhan yang nye bar len pa gzugs phung 'di yin la/ ma rig pa'i g.yo ba las 'byung ba bzhir grub pas las sna tshogs spyad/ de'i 'bras bu 'khor bar 'khor/ rigs drug tu 'khyams/ chags sdang sna tshogs kyis gzir bas/ na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad byung la/ rtogs na lha'i sku ste/ gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rnam pa'i bsgyur bsgom la ma bltos pa'am bltos kyang 'dra/ tha mal gyi zhen pa zlog par byed pa/ mthar thug na lus su grub pa med de/ spros pa dang bral ba de'i gnas lugs yin pas so// zhes shes par byas la na tsha sdug bsngal nyon mongs thams cad la spang blo ma skyes par de thog tu thog brdzis bya/

de yang*/ nyer len gzugs kyi phung po 'di// ma rtogs dus na 'byung bzhi'i lus// na tsha sdug bsngal de las byung*// rtogs na lha sku zung 'jug ste// tha mal zhen pa zlog par byed// mthar thug don la lus med de// sprin bral ltar mkha' dag go gsungs// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don bshad/ snying po lag khrid du bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje/ zhes pas stong pa nyid de/ stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'o zhes 'byung bas so// de yang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lha'i nges pas snang ba thams cad sgrib bral du bza' ba'o// gsang ba/ zhes pa spyod pa de sbas nas bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mchog thob nas/ zhes pa des thun mong gi bar pa thob cing sgyu ma tsam gyi snang ba'i bar seng 'ga' re la snang ba med pa'i ye shes dam pa la gnas pa'ang bstan no// gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro 'dun pa'i stobs/ dngos gzhi sgyu ma'i gseb lam/ rjes snying rje'i rtsal 'don pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnyan sa 'grim pa dang*/ dgon gnas gnyan por 'dug pa thams cad kyi dus lha 'dre'i gdug rtsub/ lus sems kyi bar chad/ 'jig rten gyis smod pa'i me dbal thams cad byung na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag po btang bas dogs pa'i mdun bsu/ yon tan snyan grags skyid pa sogs ma byung na dga' bas re ba'i 'phrang thams cad bkag pas dngos gzhi lam khyer gyi grogs su 'gro ba ni/ gcig byung dogs cig shos yong re ba'i 'dun pa'i khyad zhugs pas jag pa nyung ngus tshong rdal chen po 'joms nus pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ rab bcar nyal 'phrig med kyi gnad kyis gdon chos skur blta ba/ 'bring phung po gzan bskyur gyi gnad kyis gdon longs skur blta ba/ mtha' ma phung po tshogs 'khor gyi gnad kyis gdon sprul skur blta ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad kyang rang sems kyi cho 'phrul ma gtogs don logs zhig na grub pa cang med/

sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa 'di rang yin/ sems kyi rang bzhin skye 'gag med pa 'di la gshin rje'i skyes bu bye ba dung 'phyur gyi dmag gis mtha' bskor nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab kyang bsad cing bcad pa dang ngan par bsgyur du med la/ phyogs bcu'i dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od zer 'bum phrag du ma 'dus shing yon tan gyi mthu bsdoms kyang bzang por bcos su med de gshis ma bcos pa 'di rang yin no// zhes thag bcad de de la bcar nyal 'phrig med du gzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ da ltar gyi lus gzung 'dzin dang zhen pa las grub pa/ 'byung bzhi gdos bcas kyi bdag nyid 'di skyes pa'i mtha' ma 'chi bas khyed cag lha 'dre rnams la dgos na byin pas chog lar dngos po thams cad mi rtag pa 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas dus da res rang dbang yod bzhin du sems kyi sbyin pa btang na don chen po lus kyi sbyin par 'gyur snyam pas phang sems til gyi shun pa tsam yang med par sbyin/ de nas gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i 'khrul pa la lha 'dre'i gzugs brnyan mthong zhing gnod bya gnod byed du snang ba 'di rnams rab rib kyi mig la skra shad 'dzag pa ltar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rgyu ma rig pa'i dbang gis bag chags ngan pa'i rgyun goms pa las byung ba'i sgrib pa'i sgrib g.yogs glo bur gyi rnam par rtog pa sprin dang na bun lta bu yin gyis/ de la 'jigs shing skrag pa'am ya nga ba ci dgos snyam du bsams te gzhi gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi ngang der gzhag go /gsum pa la/ nyams len/ ma slongs na slong chog lhongs nas lam gtong gi gnad gsum/ dang po ni/ rang lus tha mal du gnas pa'i rnam shes phaṭ drag pos spyi bor bton/ de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku shin tu che bar gyur pa'i gri gug gis thod pa bregs/

rang byung gi thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum byung de'i khar bzhag pas stong gsum tsam du song*/ phaṭa de'i nang du lus bcug sha khrag thams cad oṃ gyis sbyangs/ āḥrtogs par byas/ hūm̐ gis sbar bas tshogs kyi longs spyod zad mi shes par gyur/ phaṭ kyis rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong yul der gnas pa sogs kyi lha 'dre thams cad bkug thams cad yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs su bsams te tshogs kyi 'khor lor longs spyad pa'i mthar/ phaṭ ces brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkhar yal bar bsams te bdag 'dzin blos btang la 'dug go /gnyis pa ni/ des lha 'dre la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul byung na/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gang rung ngam kha sbyor du mos pa'i skus srid pa gsum ni bkang*/ ha ha he he la sogs pa brgyad kyi gad mo dang bcas pa'i gar/ phyag rgya ste 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha thams cad kyis ni bsnun/ ba spu'i khung bu las khro bo pho mo dang mtshon cha dang me dpung ni 'phros/ des lha 'dre brdungs/ gtags/ bsad bcad bsregs byas par bsams te spros bcas drag po bya/ lhongs ma byung ngam gdug rtsub che na/ yang bam ro ri rab tsam du gyur pa'i lus las babs pa'i khrag gi rgya mtshor lha 'dre rnams dngangs shing 'tshubs par bsam/ yang na gnam sa mgo zhabs log de'i bar na nyi zla cha lang bzhin brdabs pa'i bar du lha 'dre rnams gzhob tu thul song bar bsam/ des ma lhongs na phag mos lus kyi pags pa bshu/ sha liṅga de la lha 'dre thams cad bstim/ pags pas gtums/ rgyu mas bkyigs/ 'og tu gshin rje'i btson khang 'brub khung gru gsum mer 'bar zhing rlung nag 'khrug pa de'i nang du hūm̐ gis nam mkhar phyar/ phaṭ kyis me dong du bskyur nas de rdo rje rgya gram gyis kha bcad/ de'i steng du phag mo nyid gser gyi mchod rten du gyur pas mnan par bsam mo// klu gdon la bya khyung 'jigs su rung bas de'i gnya' ba nas bzung ste mkha' la khyer ri rab la bskor te sder mos snying bton za bar bsam/

gsum pa ni/ cho 'phrul byung na ltas dang cho 'phrul ci byung kyang de gnyis bka' drin can nam 'dod thog tu khyer te las dang po'i gang zag le lo can rnams la brtson 'grus kyi lcags 'debs/ gnyen po glo bur du skye zhing rig pa'i ngar 'don/ 'di gnyis kyis lus ngag dge sbyor la bskul bas bsam gtan myur du skye ba'i rgyu byed pas so// lam cung zad goms pa la dran pa ye shes kyi gsos 'debs/ brtan pa thob pa la rig pa 'od gsal gyi gdangs 'don cing nang ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong*/ de la brten nas byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bas lam gyi bogs 'don du 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa ni/ dus de thams cad du lha 'dre de dag la sogs pa sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje drag po sha la bab pa tsam du sgom/ de thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa la brtson pa dang rtul ba brtan par bya'o// des bdud rigs chos skyong du zhal mthong zhing*/ chos skyong sprul skur mthong bas rkyen dngos grub tu babs/ bar chad lam du longs/ rnam rtog chos skur shar/ skyon yon tan du grol bas thun mong lam gyi mthun rkyen thams cad de dag gis sgrub/ mthar thug shes bya'i gshis la lha 'dre gnyis ka ma grub/ re dogs spong len gyi mtshan ma rang sar grol bas 'khrul pa gzhi med du rtogs shing 'khor ba phyag rgya chen por shar ba de la glo bur gyi rtog pa dbyings su thim pa'i chos sku 'du 'bral med pa zhes ming gis btags so// de yang*/ gdon gnod sbyin pho mor snang ba 'di// ma rtogs dus na bdud yin te// tho 'tsham bar du gcod par byed// rtogs na bgegs rnams chos skyong ste// sna tshogs dngos grub de las 'byung*// mthar thug don la lha 'dre med// rnam rtog zad sar phyin no gsung*// zhes pas so// de dag rtsa rgyud las/

mtshan mo rtag par gcer bu ste// gnag dang dmar bar rtag tu 'gyur// srog chags yan lag na bzar gyon// bde ba 'dod pa'i bde bskyod bya// mchod phyir thogs ni yongs spangs la// zhes dang*/ rgyas par/ 'bab chu'i 'gram dang rgya mtsho dang*// ri bo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// lteng ka khron pa mtshe'u dang*// khang stong dang ni lam srang dag /thams cad du ni mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu zhen par blta la gnas// 'jigs pa chen po dur khrod du// sogs kyis/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje'i snod du pad+ma mchog /kha sbyar gyis zhu ba pad+ma las log nas/ rdo rje dga' bzhi yang dag brtson// zhes pa/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byed pas thabs shes gnyis med pas snang ba thams cad he ru kar sbyor ba ste/ 'di rtsa rgyud las/ gtsang sbra shrī he ru kar gnas// phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan// sgrub pa po yi dngos grub brtson// zhes pas bshad de bod du mkho ba ma yin la/ rgyas par gzhan du bshad zin to// bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje'i thugs mchog thob par bgyi// zhes pa ni brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rdzogs nas phyag rgya dang*/ lhan cig zhag gcig gam bdun gyi mthar thug pas mngon par byang chub pa lngas 'tshang rgya ba'o// 'di yang rtsa rgyud las/ rigs dang rigs min ngor mi lta// spyi gtsug la sogs bcing pa spangs// zhes pas bstan no// gsum pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ dus gtan bya rog gdong nang du// klu dang ru sbal rtsangs pa dang*// brgya byin gzhu rgyal gtan du bcings// zhes pa gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i phyed du rlung stong brgya pa re dbu mar thim pas byang chub sems kyis de'i phyed gang*/ sa dang po 'thob/ de lta bu'i 'gros kyis gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'dab kyi phyed man gang bas sa bcu gcig pa/ sa de yang rtsa rgyud las/ gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa// de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med// zhing 'di 'od byed shes par bya// nye ba'i zhing 'di 'od 'phro ba// tshan do ha ni mngon gyur cing*// nye ba'i tshan do sbyang dka' ba// 'dus pa ring du song ba yin// nye ba'i 'dus pa mi g.yo ba// dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid// nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin// zhes pa las ma gsungs la/

mngon brjod du/ dpe med pa dang ye shes ldan// zhes pas 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod rim pa bzhin sbyar la/ pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams ni// zhes rgyu'i theg pa'i phar phyin bcu/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i las kyi phar phyin dang*/ rin po che pad+ma'i phar phyin gnyis bsnan nas slob sa bcu gcig go /tshe 'dir lhag bcas yod min la// lhag med chen po 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pa ji ltar rgyu'i theg pa la grags pa'i lhag bcas myang 'das dang lhag med myang 'das lta bu ma yin gyi/ dri med 'od las/ 'dir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams ni lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhag ma thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ lhag ma kun las rnam grol zhing*// nam mkha'i lam la rab gnas pa// zhes pa de yin/ nam mkha' rdo rje'i grong du zhugs pa 'di la ma'i rgyud sde las rig ma'i skyes bu dang pha'i rgyud sde las rig pa'i skyes bur bshad kyang don zung 'jug ma ning gi go 'phang ste/ mtshan nyid kha sbyor yan lag bdun nam 'bras bu'i dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las thos// rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rdo rje 'chang las thos pa/ e ma rdo rje'i slob ma la// gsang ba'i gnas su 'di bshad do// rlung sems ma lus sgra gcan nang*// brtan du 'ching bar bstan no khyed// zhes pas gzhan la spel bar gdams pa'o// 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs byas pa las/ dge ba gang zhig sel med mnyam bsgrubs pas// de yis 'jig rten rtog pa'i dri ma yi// sgrib pa bsal nas yun ring zhi bar shog /yongs su bsngo ba'o// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /de ltar lho phyogs kyi rigs ldan chen po grags pas gzhan la bgo bshar byas pa'i rdo rje'i tshig mang po dus kyis 'chun pa dka' bas zin bris kyi yi ge nyung ngu snying gi nor bu zhes bya ba bdag gi skal bar bzhag pa ltar/

bla ma chen po a ba dhū tī pa btsun mo can las bka' drin thob pa/ gangs ri'i paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma dkar pos rje dam pa de'i rigs dbon rnam dpyod ldan pa chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ gsal rje bla ma skal bzang dbang pos kyang bskul ba ltar/ dge bsnyen chen po gsal rje'i lha zhol yar 'dren byang chub sman gyi ljongs zhes bya ba'i shug gseb tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa rin chen bstan pa rgyal mtshan no// thams cad 'dir zhugs nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /tshe 'dir sbyang yun mngal gyis ma dub par// legs bshad kun shes bu yis phang mdzes pa// 'di ci blo gsal rgya mtsho yid dga' ba'i// snying gi grogs mo min na gzhan pa su// 'di na bsngags 'os rin chen lnga pa'i dung*// kun shes khyab 'jug zhal sgor chags pa des// rgyud sder don bzang ci 'od dril bsgrags pas// mchog gnyer skye dgu'i tshogs rnams cis mi dga'// tshigs bcad lag pa brkyang ba re re'i khar// bla ma las kyang bla mar byed kun gyis// yid bzhin nor bu ster 'di mtshon nus pa// zas gtsang bu yi seng ge'i khri kho na/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
